subject: Bridge & bounty framework for renewal + expansion
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Patricia Gomez <pat.gomez@lumenretail.com>, procurement@lumenretail.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Bridge & bounty framework for renewal + expansion

Hi Patricia / Lumen team —

Thanks again for the call yesterday. Per our discussion, I wanted to put a concise outline on email so procurement and legal have something to review before we put a formal SOW in DocuSign. High level: Lumen is renewing for 12 months and targeting an immediate capacity expansion (approx +35% token volume / new "Search Assist" use case).

Proposed commercial structure (summary):
- Term: 12 months with an option to extend at the same rates for a second 12-month period.
- Expansion commit: incremental 35% commit blended into the term; we model true‑up quarterly.
- Pricing ladder: base renewal discount (15%) with step-ups to 25% at committed volume thresholds.
- Bridge credit (one-time): a short-term credit to smooth the rate during onboarding (applied to first two invoices).
- Bounty credits (new): a one-time pool of credits (USD value) awarded partly on signature and partly tied to activation of the new Search Assist workload. Rationale: helps Lumen offset integration costs and aligns both parties around activation velocity.

Operational asks / notes:
- We propose a 6-month price‑hold on the core model family following go‑live; overage rates capped at 1.5x post-cap to avoid runaway bills.
- Net30 invoice terms, quarterly true‑up; we can support milestone invoicing for the activation period if preferred.
- Security: if you need the VPC addendum/NDA we can route through Legal; feel free to share the security questionnaire and we’ll attach SOC2 evidence.

Attachments: I’m including an initial pricing matrix and a draft SOW (attachment stubs below).

Next step: can you confirm (a) the target monthly token baseline for the expansion (ballpark number is fine), and (b) whether procurement prefers a single DocuSign SOW or separate commercial + SOW documents? If we get those, I’ll circulate a revised SOW + DocuSign link tomorrow.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555‑0182

Attachments:
- redwood-bridge-bounty-pricing-v1.xlsx (pricing matrix, tiers & bounty allocation)
- LumenRetail_SOW_draft_20260719.pdf (draft SOW, milestones & success criteria)

From: Patricia Gomez <pat.gomez@lumenretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@lumenretail.com, ciso@lumenretail.com
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bridge & bounty framework for renewal + expansion

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the summary — helpful. A few quick clarifications from procurement & security so we can move to internal review: 

1) Bounty credits — we like the idea conceptually. How are credits applied on the invoice (line‑item credit vs. rebate)? Can unused credits roll forward into the next quarter or are they one‑time only?

2) Price‑hold — can you confirm which model families are included in the 6‑month hold and whether there’s any carveout for external third‑party models we might probe?

3) True‑up cadence — procurement prefers monthly true‑up for forecasting, but we’re open to quarterly if you can provide a clear forecast template.

4) Security questionnaire — attached is our standard vendor questionnaire (we’ll send offline). CISO has asked for SOC 2 Type II and a short note on data retention for embeddings/indexes.

Finally — we prefer a single DocuSign SOW for signature (commercial terms summarized in the SOW). Can you share an updated SOW + the DocuSign link? We’ll route it through Legal and Procurement.

Patricia Gomez
VP, Procurement — LumenRetail
pat.gomez@lumenretail.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 13:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bridge & bounty framework for renewal + expansion (internal)

Marissa — quick internal note before you reply to Patricia. I like their ask on monthly true‑up; operationally that’s reasonable if we include a conservative forecast band. A couple of suggested concessions to speed signature: 

- Increase step-up discount ceiling: change the top discount from 25% to 28% if Lumen signs for the full blended commit we discussed.
- Bounty split: 50% of bounty credits paid on signature (applied as line‑item credit across first invoices) and 50% unlocked based on activation milestones (activation = production Search Assist handling >10k requests/day for two consecutive weeks). Any unused bounty credits expire at the end of the first 90 days after go‑live.
- Price‑hold: apply to the "Redwood Gen" model family and our first‑party quantized variants; carve out third‑party models (we can list exceptions in the SOW). Price‑hold duration: 6 months from go‑live.
- Overage cap: keep 1.5x cap but add a 30% pre‑notification threshold so both teams get a heads up and can adjust capacity.

I attached an internal pricing matrix (redwood-bridge-bounty-pricing-v1.xlsx) with these adjustments — can you confirm you’re OK to send that version to Patricia? If Legal needs to tweak the bounty wording we can hand off a short addendum rather than re‑draft the entire contract.

Ben
Ben Carter | Director, Commercials
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Patricia Gomez <pat.gomez@lumenretail.com>, procurement@lumenretail.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, ciso@lumenretail.com
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 15:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bridge & bounty framework for renewal + expansion

Patricia — thanks, and appreciate the quick questions. Per Ben/Grace input above, I’ve updated the SOW and pricing matrix to explicitly call out the bounty mechanics and the model families covered by the price‑hold. Key clarifications below: 

- Bounty credits: 50% applied as a line‑item credit across the first two invoices on signature; 50% unlocked by activation milestones (production Search Assist threshold). Unused credits expire 90 days after go‑live (no roll‑forward).
- Invoice/true‑up cadence: we can support monthly true‑up for forecast alignment. We’ll send a forecast template along with the SOW.
- Price‑hold: applies to Redwood Gen and first‑party quantized variants only; third‑party and external vendor models are carveouts. Hold lasts 6 months post go‑live.
- Security: attaching SOC 2 Type II summary and our short retention note for embeddings; we’ll send the full questionnaire answers via secure Share (or attach if you prefer).

Attachments included (updated):
- LumenRetail_SOW_draft_20260721.pdf (SOW with milestones & activation acceptance criteria)
- redwood-bridge-bounty-pricing-v1.xlsx (pricing + bounty allocation — updated)
- Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf (SOC 2 Type II summary)

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/prepare/abc123-sign — I’ve prepared a single SOW with the commercial summary embedded. If that looks good, please route for signature and copy me on Legal.

If you want, I can schedule a 30‑minute sync midweek to walk Procurement & CISO through the activation milestones and billing flow — helps avoid back‑and‑forth.

Best,
Marissa
